title: BillionMail: Own Your Email. Send Smarter. Scale Limitlessly.  — GitHub Trending #github
description:
Forget overpriced SaaS and restrictive sending limits — BillionMail is the open-source mail server + newsletter + email marketing stack built for people who want full control. Self-host it, scale it, and send newsletters, transactional emails, and campaigns without begging third-party platforms for permission.

 #opensource #github #emailmarketing #selfhosted
